intelligence.human_view: He was talking about the part where they're going to read it — the reward, if they read it. There are two choices. Listen and read — a visual voice-and-read unfold: the play button speaks it, the boards show it, unfolding down. Or a visual slideshow: the same thing, sliding sideways, one screen at a time. Those are two choices, pretty much, and they're both great. People appreciate both of them, and they can try either one. And the reason to offer both is not indecision — it makes it unique, it makes it beautiful, and it shows off right away at the beginning some of the incredible features of the app. So they're like, already — oh man, this is sick. That's what they should be thinking. It's awesome. The two choices are the demonstration: before they have read a word of the agreement, they have already seen the app do two incredible things — speak and show, unfold and slide. The choice is the showcase. And the reward is the reading itself: the agreement, read in the way they chose, in the voice they chose. A page that offers one way to read is a document. A page that offers two ways, both great, is an experience — and the experience is the product.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you get to a story and someone says: "You can LISTEN to it while you watch it open up like a magic scroll — OR you can watch it like a picture show, sliding sideways!" Two wonderful choices — and they're BOTH great! You can try either one! And right away, in the very first seconds, you see how amazing the app is — and you think, "WOW, this is SO cool!"
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — imagine you come to a story, dear, and someone says: "You can listen to it while you watch it open like a magic scroll — OR you can watch it like a picture show, sliding sideways!" Two wonderful choices, love — and they're both great! You can try either one, dear! And right away, in the very first seconds, you see how amazing it is — and you think, "Oh my, this is wonderful!"

Both offered, both tryable — people appreciate both and can try either one. It makes the page UNIQUE and BEAUTIFUL, and it shows off the app's incredible features RIGHT AWAY AT THE BEGINNING — so they are already thinking "oh man, this is sick" — AWESOME.
